notes.title: Patch 1.2.4.2
notes.content:
[b]ChangeList[/b]
[list]
[*] Remodelled all kitchen surfaces
[*] Major optimization pass
[*] Relocated Deliverbee Customer Location
[*] Deep fryer will despawn food that not supposed to be there
[*] Potato Chips will have a hard spawn limit
[*] Reduced movement on all levels
[*] Burnt food will despawn after a delay
[*] Cracked eggshells will despawn
[*] Readjusted COCO spawning location
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Overspawning Plates, causing them to collide into each other
[*] Fixed Mash potato dishes not despawning between arcade waves
[*] Fixed DoubleSpawning Pause feedback graphics
[*] Fixed Order Point Locking out when baby receives an icecream bribe
[*] Fixed Kebab sometimes not replenishing
[*] Fixed Users being able to double-submit their arcade score to the leaderboard
[*] Fixed Kebab Shortage sometimes causing a crash
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Greetings contestants! Arcade mode has finally arrived.
If you feel you're up to the challenge, survive as long as you can and have your performance immortalized on our leaderboard for everyone to see!

[b]Change list[/b]
	
[list]
[*] Sped up entire gameplay loop to feel more fluid and snappy.
[*] Removed unnecessary walking animations for all customers. Soon after being served customers will vanish instead   
[*] Increased respawn speed for most ingredients
[*] Arcade mode is now enabled for public
[*] Added Arcade Leaderboard
[*] Reduced the amount of walking needed each time level is restarted
[/list]


[b]Bugfixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the beer mug sometimes not respawning
[*] Fixed Vegetable ingredients sometimes over spawning
[*] Fixed Jacket potatoes and pizzas burning a bit too quickly

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed ingredients sometimes flying all over upon kitchen transformation end

[*] Fixed over-spawning ingredients when dispensers are not fully empty

[*] Fixed Front surface and griddle collisions allowing players to get stuck in them if they walk into them while they are transforming

[*] Fixed Boss Fight score tracker screen sometimes not spawning (right under counter)

[*] Fixed the Boss 4 Kraken Animations sometimes being off sync and grabbing a different customer 

[*] Fixed Kraken Tentacles attempting to grab customers that have walked away
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Redid spawn delays on all ingredients after player grabs them from dispensers, will be most noticeable with eggs / lettuce as they will spawn immediately after being grabbed

[*] Retuned Boss 2 and 6 on Casual difficulty to be more in tune with the others

[*] Removed boat roofing for better kraken visibility during boss fight 4

[*] Changed Coco (Cooking companion bot) sliding locations to never block the customer timer view and overall stay out of they players face.

[*] Retuned Chopping of vegetables, sausages and chicken strips to be more forgiving
[/list]



If you do encounter any new issues do not hesitate to contact us directly or join us at our discord https://discord.gg/xbsNhyB

notes.title: Manual Drinks dispenser and Boss difficulty tweaks
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the glitchy floor collision around kitchen deploy area

notes.title: First Post-Launch hotfix patch
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Cheese when added to dish will no longer sometimes create a clone of itself and stay floating in the air

[*] Coco (that little robot companion) should no longer complain about burning food as soon as it's done cooking. This warning will now be properly issued when food is actually about to burn.

[*] Input bindings Screen in the MainMenu should correctly display the bindings on your currently active VR system.
[/list]

[b]Quality of life changes
[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlocked Achievements now will also appear in game (IN VR) with a celebratory tune
[i]Achievements were working before, we just did not had a visual indicator in game when you earned one. [/i] 

[*]Tutorial videos are now shorter and snappier.
[i]We noticed that many of you rarely pay attention or rather don't watch them fully thus they don't really serve their purpose, hopefully this will alleviate the problem :)[/i]
[/list]

If you do encounter any new issues do not hesitate to contact us directly or join us at our discord https://discord.gg/xbsNhyB

Happy Holidays!
Slapunas & Jakayaki
